title: Alarm Beeps
blurb: Four sharp alarm beeps, engineered to trigger instant low-level panic in any room. The clip's strength is ambiguity: it reads equally as a fire alarm, a microwave, or a smoke detector with a dying battery, so listeners can't dismiss it without checking. That's exactly what makes it top-tier prank material — play it from a hidden phone and watch a group perform a full security sweep of the kitchen. Also useful in edits whenever a situation needs to escalate from awkward to genuinely alarming.
origin: Original synthesis modeled on generic appliance and alarm beeps.
